name: octodns-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is octoDNS, a DNS-as-code toolkit: it loads DNS records for zones
from YAML files and other sources, validates record types, values and whole zones, supports dynamic
(geo, weighted and subnet-targeted) records, runs processors that filter or add records, computes
plans of changes between desired and existing zones with safety checks, and applies them to target
providers, all driven by a Manager configuration file and the `octodns-*` commands.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the octoDNS core package: every module under octodns/ other than the generated table octodns/record/geo_data.py, together with README.md, the documentation pages docs/index.rst, docs/getting-started.rst, docs/records.rst, docs/configuration.rst, docs/include_directive.rst, docs/dynamic_zone_config.rst, docs/dynamic_records.rst, docs/zone_lifecycle.rst and docs/auto_arpa.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow
